name: Capability Selection
description: Declares one module-scoped capability requested by the Site.
purpose: Provides a stable manifest shape before Phase 17 publishes the canonical Module/Capability Registry.

fields.description: Whether the Site requests the capability.

relationships.description: Phase 17 Module Registry is authoritative for module/capability existence and dependencies.

validationRules.description: Module and capability IDs must exist in the Phase 17 Module Registry and satisfy dependency/ownership rules.
Once the Module Registry is authoritative, undeclared capabilities must fail manifest validation.

delivery.notes: Manifest definitions contain technical declarations only. Secret values are prohibited.
